# Wavel Documentation

- [Introduction](https://docs.wavel.app/): Understand Wavel and choose where to begin.
- [Install Wavel](https://docs.wavel.app/get-started/install/): Install Wavel on Windows or macOS.
- [Create a wallet](https://docs.wavel.app/get-started/create-wallet/): Create a wallet and secure its recovery phrase.
- [Import a wallet](https://docs.wavel.app/get-started/import-wallet/): Restore compatible accounts from a recovery phrase.
- [Accounts and networks](https://docs.wavel.app/wallet/accounts-and-networks/): Understand accounts, addresses, and network context.
- [Receive assets](https://docs.wavel.app/wallet/receive/): Receive assets on the correct account and network.
- [Send assets](https://docs.wavel.app/wallet/send/): Review and submit a transfer safely.
- [Network fees](https://docs.wavel.app/wallet/network-fees/): Keep the native balance required for network fees.
- [Tokens](https://docs.wavel.app/assets/tokens/): Identify and manage native coins and custom tokens.
- [Collectibles](https://docs.wavel.app/assets/collectibles/): Discover, add, hide, and send collectibles.
- [Portfolio balances](https://docs.wavel.app/assets/portfolio/): Understand how Wavel estimates portfolio value.
- [Swaps](https://docs.wavel.app/assets/swaps/): Review routes, approvals, slippage, and swap costs.
- [Connect to dApps](https://docs.wavel.app/apps/connect-dapps/): Connect an account and review signing requests.
- [Disconnect and revoke](https://docs.wavel.app/apps/disconnect-revoke/): End sessions and remove on-chain permissions.
- [Security](https://docs.wavel.app/security/): Protect your wallet, recovery phrase, and transactions.
